title: IT Solaris System Administrator
description:

The Oracle Solaris System Administrator will be responsible for setting up servers, installing servers, creating and implementing Linux configurations, networking servers, and troubleshooting.
The Oracle Solaris System Administrator looks after design, installation, maintenance, and retirement of the systems, application server, WebLogic Server, data, security of the systems that are at the core of the organization, This role is responsible for the Technical and server Administration for infrastructure: Designing, building and implementing IT infrastructure; Proving timely and high-quality completion of projects (Tasks and request and ensuring the IT infrastructure environment is up to data through proactive auditing and Patch management.

Keeping track of developing trends in data center technologies.

Make sure the Data Center standard procedure followed by the team, units and vendor
efficiently.

About Organization for Sustainable Integrated Development ( OSID )
About OSID (Organization Background)
The Organization for Sustainable Integrated Development (OSID) is a non-partisan, non-governmental organization established in 2012 and registered as a non-profit entity with the Ministry of Economy in Afghanistan. OSID holds ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System) and ISO 31000:2018 (Risk Management System) certifications, demonstrating its dedication to high standards of service delivery, client satisfaction, and proactive risk mitigation. OSID provides professional humanitarian and development services across Afghanistan using integrated, community-centered, and technology-driven approaches.

Job Descriptions
Position Summary / Objective
The SCOPE / ICT Officer will manage technical operations, digital beneficiary registration, biometric data collection, and IT infrastructure for the emergency response project in Helmand and Nimroz. The incumbent will be responsible for administering the SCOPE database operations, configuring registration hardware (biometric scanners, tablets, printers), ensuring data integrity and synchronization, troubleshooting ICT issues at distribution points, and upholding strict data protection standards.
4. Key Responsibilities & Operational Duties
SCOPE Administration & Biometric Registration:
· Oversee all beneficiary registration, verification, biometric capturing, card printing, and data synchronization processes using WFP's SCOPE platform.
· Prepare, clean, validate, and upload household targeting lists into SCOPE, ensuring 100% compliance with verification guidelines and eliminating duplicates.
· Manage offline/online data syncing across field kits, resolving database errors, token issues, and biometric matching discrepancies.
ICT Field Infrastructure & Technical Support:
· Deploy, configure, and maintain hardware kits (biometric readers, SCOPE field equipment, tablets, power banks, network gear) at distribution sites in Helmand and Nimroz.
· Provide real-time technical support to distribution teams, registration staff, and help desk operators during field registration and distribution campaigns.
· Ensure reliable internet connectivity, satellite/cellular routers, data backup systems, and cyber-security protocols across field operations.
Data Security, Quality Control & Reporting:
· Implement strict data protection and confidentiality protocols in line with humanitarian principles and organizational data policies.
· Generate disaggregated beneficiary coverage reports, transaction reconciliation summaries, and SCOPE activity dashboards for the Project Manager and MEAL team.
· Maintain a detailed ICT asset inventory, tracking hardware allocation, maintenance logs, and field kit status.

Job Requirements
Qualifications & Requirements
· Mandatory WFP SCOPE Experience: Direct experience in WFP SCOPE system administration, biometric beneficiary registration, and data management in Afghanistan is MANDATORY.
· Work Experience: Minimum 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in database management, ICT infrastructure support, and biometric systems in humanitarian projects.
· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
· Technical Competencies: Expert technical knowledge of SCOPE operations, hardware setup, network troubleshooting, database management (SQL/Excel), and mobile data collection tools (KoBo Toolbox, ODK).
· Contextual Knowledge: Proven familiarity with the field realities and operational context in Helmand and Nimroz Provinces.
· Languages: Fluency in written and spoken Pashto, Dari, and English.
· Key Competencies: Strong analytical skills, problem-solving ability, and high commitment to beneficiary data privacy.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Role Summary
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting and strengthening the organization’s ISP and enterprise network infrastructure with a primary focus on network-level security architecture, routing, and switching environments. This role ensures the secure design, deployment, and operation of core and edge network systems, including firewalls, VPN gateways, routing platforms, and switching infrastructure.
The engineer will work with multi-vendor network security technologies such as Juniper SRX, Huawei, Sophos, and other enterprise security platforms, ensuring secure connectivity, traffic control, and threat prevention across backbone, access, and corporate networks. The role requires strong expertise in network protocols, traffic analysis, and secure network design to support highly available and resilient telecom environments.

Duties and Responsibilities
Duties and Responsibilities:
Network Security Architecture & Operations
Design, implement, and maintain network-level security controls across core, distribution, and access layers.
Secure routing and switching infrastructure including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, and VLAN environments.
Configure and manage firewalls, IPS/IDS, and VPN gateways across multi-vendor platforms.
Implement and maintain network segmentation, VRF, VLAN architecture, and secure traffic isolation.
Apply and manage NAT, ACLs, port security, control-plane protection, and secure device management (SSH, AAA, TACACS+/RADIUS).
Support secure integration between ISP backbone, data centers, and enterprise networks.
Network Monitoring & Threat Detection
Monitor network traffic, flows, and logs to detect anomalies, attacks, and performance issues.
Analyze traffic patterns using network monitoring and security tools.
Identify and mitigate DDoS attacks, routing anomalies, and network-based threats.
Collaborate with NOC and security teams to maintain network availability and security posture.
Incident Response & Vulnerability Management

title: Information Technology Advisor
description:
Role Summary
The IT Advisor serves as an independent advisor to the Board of Management and provides strategic guidance, oversight, and recommendations regarding the Bank's information technology environment. The position is responsible for reviewing the effectiveness of IT governance, cybersecurity controls, IT operations, technology risks, digital initiatives, and regulatory compliance, and reporting observations and recommendations directly to the Board of Management.
The IT Advisor shall independently assess the activities, controls, performance, and risk management practices of the Information Technology Department and provide professional advice to support sound decision-making and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities
1. IT Governance and Oversight
Review the effectiveness of the Bank's IT governance framework.
Assess whether IT activities are aligned with the Bank's strategic objectives.
Advise the Board of Management on technology-related matters and emerging risks.
Monitor compliance with Board-approved IT policies, procedures, and standards.
Evaluate the adequacy of management oversight over IT operations.
2. IT Risk Management
Review the effectiveness of IT risk management practices.
Assess technology-related risks affecting the Bank's operations.
Advise the Board on significant IT risks and mitigation measures.
Monitor risk indicators relating to cybersecurity, infrastructure, applications, and data management.
Evaluate the Bank's readiness to address technology disruptions and cyber threats.
3. Cybersecurity Oversight
Review cybersecurity controls and security governance practices.
Assess compliance with information security policies and regulatory requirements.
Monitor cybersecurity incidents and corrective actions.
Evaluate vulnerability assessment and penetration testing results.
Advise the Board on cybersecurity improvements and emerging threats.
4. Review of IT Operations
Review the performance and effectiveness of the IT Department.
Assess the adequacy of IT infrastructure, systems, and services.
Monitor system availability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Evaluate change management, system implementation, and project governance practices.
Review major IT projects and provide recommendations to the Board.
5. Regulatory Compliance
Monitor compliance with Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB) regulations, directives, and guidelines relating to information technology and information security.
Review implementation of regulatory recommendations and audit findings.
Advise the Board regarding regulatory developments affecting technology operations.
6. Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
Review the effectiveness of business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements.
Assess disaster recovery testing results and corrective actions.
Evaluate the Bank's ability to maintain critical services during disruptions.
Provide recommendations for strengthening operational resilience.
7. Reporting to the Board of Management
Prepare independent reports for the Board of Management regarding:
IT governance effectiveness.
Information security and cybersecurity status.
Technology risks and mitigation measures.
IT operational performance.
Regulatory compliance status.
Significant technology incidents.
Progress of major IT projects.
Present findings, observations, and recommendations during Board meetings.
Escalate significant concerns requiring Board attention.
8. Advisory Role
Provide independent advice on:
Digital transformation initiatives.
Core banking systems.
Information security programs.
Technology investments.
Outsourcing and vendor management.
Emerging technologies and innovation.
Support management and the Board in making informed technology decisions.
9. IT Procurement and Technology Acquisition Oversight
Review and provide independent advice on the procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, subscriptions, cybersecurity solutions, network equipment, and technology-related services.
Participate in the evaluation and selection process of IT vendors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure transparency, value for money, and alignment with the Bank's strategic objectives.
Assess technical specifications, requirements, and procurement proposals prior to submission for approval.
Ensure that all IT procurements comply with the Bank's procurement policies, information security requirements, and applicable regulatory directives.
Review technology contracts, service-level agreements (SLAs), maintenance agreements, and licensing arrangements from a technical and governance perspective.
Provide recommendations to the Board of Management regarding major technology investments and procurements.
Monitor the implementation and delivery of procured IT solutions to ensure that the Bank receives the agreed products and services.
Advise management and the Board on technology standardization, vendor risks, system compatibility, scalability, and cost optimization.
Participate as a technical advisor in procurement committees whenever technology-related procurements are being evaluated.
Review and advise on all significant technology expenditures, including core banking systems, digital banking platforms, cybersecurity solutions, data center infrastructure, cloud services, and outsourced technology services.

Job Requirements
Education
Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Professional Certifications (Preferred)
CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
CGEIT (Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT)
COBIT Certification
Experience
Minimum 10 years of experience in banking technology, information security, IT governance, IT audit, or technology risk management.
At least 5 years in a senior managerial, advisory, audit, or governance role.
Experience in banking and financial institutions is strongly preferred.
Competencies

Strong analytical and reporting skills.
